folder.title: Service folder
folder.text:
A service slip is tucked into the otherwise ordinary folder.

COMBINATION ORDER: desk extension / access-unit number / filing reference.

FILING REFERENCE: 61.

Gordon has filed his memory under 'somebody else's problem'.

telephone.title: Telephone label
telephone.text:
The extension label under the handset reads 38.

You do not make a call. Breaking into an office is awkward enough without leaving a voicemail.

access.title: Access-unit plate
access.text:
The entrance interlock is already released.

A separate identification plate reads UNIT 24. This is its equipment number, not its firmware version.

emptyContents:
Expense claims. Spare letterheads. A deeply unnecessary number of rubber stamps.

Nothing here explains what happened to John. The safe was better protected than its contents deserved.
